requirements: Restart Safety and Durability Barrier acceptance criteria, QUORUS_RAFT_WAL_DESIGN.md section 18
slices.acceptanceStatement: After a full-cluster restart every controller recovers the same committed log and elects a leader. A follower that receives overlapping AppendEntries for the same index persists it once, a leader that receives overlapping submits reserves distinct indices, recovery keys journal records by index, and a follower keeps its election timer when it rejects a vote request.
slices.failureBoundary: ThreeControllerDurableRestartTest failed under full-suite load: followers replayed four log entries where the leader replayed three, rejected the leader as not up to date, and the leader started 40 elections in 15 s while the followers never timed out.

red.expectedFailure: WAL must hold each index exactly once ==> expected [1, 2] but was [1, 2, 1]; follower never started its own election while rejecting a stale candidate for 3 s
red.outcome: failed as expected before production implementation

green.patchIdentity: working implementation patch based on 219e307, committed as 176dbee

refactorSummary: RaftNode serializes every log mutation behind the previous one (serializeLogMutation) on both the follower AppendEntries path and the leader submit path.
Recovery keys replayed records by index: a same-term repeat is ignored, a different-term record supersedes the tail from that index, and a gap fails recovery.
stepDown keeps a running follower election timer; only leaving the leader or candidate role arms a fresh one.
